segments.text: Occult science (Spiritual science) deals with hidden spiritual forces, both divine and negative. This blog explains how it works with examples of two devotees of Lord Hanuman Ji Maharaj
Two Devotees and Their Spiritual Journeys
There are two people from families that have worshipped Lord Hanuman Ji for generations:

Person A – He has Lord Hanuman Ji with him but becomes arrogant about it. When Hanumanji appeared, he asked for a wish, that no one could argue with him and that he could know everything about others.

Person B – He has some negative energy with him but is a true devotee of Lord Hanuman Ji. He performs rituals like hawan, jaap (chanting), and sadhana (spiritual practice) purely to please Hanuman Ji. Surprisingly, this negative energy helps him, and he encourages people to worship Hanuman Ji.
Who is Greater – Hanuman Ji or the Negative Energy?

Hanuman Ji Maharaj is universal energy. Person A’s worship helped him gain some of Hanuman Ji’s divine energy (tattva), but he became arrogant. On the other hand, Person B continued his devotion despite his struggles. Because of his true devotion, his prayers were answered more than those of Person A.
This teaches us that what truly matters is:
The kind of person you are
Your devotion and worship
Your good deeds for humanity
If Person B continues worshipping, even the negativity with him will transform into something higher and eventually become “Bhrampret” (a powerful spiritual being under Hanuman Ji).
The Power of Worship
This idea can also be seen in history:
Arjun spent most of his life with Lord Krishna but only reached heaven after death.
Meera Bai and Sabari, who worshipped their God their entire lives, attained the highest spiritual level.
This proves that devotion is more important than being close to God in the physical world.
How Negative Energies Work in Occult Science?
It takes only three days to get work done using negative energies, while it may take years using divine energies. That’s why many Tantriks (black magic practitioners) prefer negative forces.
If a Tantrik uses negative energy all his life, he becomes a negative energy himself after death, bound to serve the same forces he once commanded.
There is no specific place for these negative energies, so they roam freely. Ancient Tantriks knew this, so they created a separate “lok” (realm) for them, providing them with energy and protection.
How Negative Energies Drain Human Energy?
Tantriks studied human energy sources and discovered the Universal Cosmic Energy, which comes from higher spiritual lok. This energy is essential for human life and spiritual growth.

Originally, Tantriks only took energy from people who didn’t worship. However, over time, they became greedy and started draining energy from devotees as well. This caused suffering, and people prayed for help.
Divine Intervention
Lord Shiva noticed this, and Hanuman Ji Maharaj appointed three divine warriors to help. One of them is Bhaiya & with the help of gurudev, he freed many astral bodies trapped by Tantriks.
When Bhaiya ji confronted a Tantrik, he asked:
“Why are you taking energy from devotees? Isn’t that breaking the rules?”
The Tantrik replied:

“At first, these devotees never worshipped, so we had the right to take their energies. Humans don’t understand the value of their body and devotion. If they don’t use their spiritual energy, we will.”
What Happens If a Tantrik Takes Your Spiritual Energy?
Even if someone continues to worship, their devotion will not be effective.
They will not receive divine blessings, no matter how much they pray.
Final Thoughts

This blog shows that true devotion is more powerful than both divine and negative energies. Negative forces may grant quick results, but they come at a cost. In the end, only sincere worship and good deeds bring true spiritual success.
